svg.title: post-provision pipeline
svg.desc: The post-provision pipeline has 23 tasks. Workspace: load-config (reads ConfigMap fleet-pipeline-config; its results are parameters of the later tasks); git-clone (clones the fleet repository, which holds workloads/, into the shared workspace); extract-spoke-kubeconfig (extracts the admin kubeconfig from the Hive Secret into the workspace); save-spoke-kubeconfig (stores the kubeconfig in hub Secret NAME-spoke-kubeconfig); create-cluster-cronjob (creates CronJob NAME in namespace default with the cluster's timezone and schedule). Identity and TLS: openshift-cluster: register-keycloak-client (creates or updates the OIDC client of the cluster in the hub Keycloak); configure-spoke-oauth (writes the htpasswd and OIDC client Secrets and the OAuth CR to the spoke); create-cluster-issuer (creates ClusterIssuer letsencrypt-NAME: Let's Encrypt DNS-01 through Route53); request-ssl-cert (creates Certificate NAME-wildcard-certificate in openshift-ingress on the hub); wait-for-ssl-ready (waits for condition Ready on the Certificate; timeout 20m); extract-cert-material (copies tls.crt and tls.key into hub Secret NAME-leaf-cert); configure-spoke-default-cert (applies the leaf Secret to the spoke and sets it as the default ingress certificate). Workloads: apply-base-workloads (runs kustomize build on workloads/base and applies the output to the spoke); apply-virt-workloads (installs Node Feature Discovery and OpenShift Virtualization on the spoke); add-baremetal-workers (creates a bare-metal worker MachinePool on the hub); apply-ai-workloads (installs the OpenShift AI 2.x or 3.x operators on the spoke; GPU operators for nvidia-gpu); add-ai-workers (creates a GPU worker MachinePool on the hub); prepare-podvm-aws (reads the worker network from EC2 and opens the pod VM ports on its security groups); build-podvm-image-aws (builds or reuses the pod VM AMI of the cluster; timeout 2h); apply-coco-workloads (installs sandboxed containers with peer pods on the spoke; timeout 2h). tier: virt: apply-virt-workloads (installs Node Feature Discovery and OpenShift Virtualization on the spoke); add-baremetal-workers (creates a bare-metal worker MachinePool on the hub). tier: ai: apply-ai-workloads (installs the OpenShift AI 2.x or 3.x operators on the spoke; GPU operators for nvidia-gpu); add-ai-workers (creates a GPU worker MachinePool on the hub). tier: coco: prepare-podvm-aws (reads the worker network from EC2 and opens the pod VM ports on its security groups); build-podvm-image-aws (builds or reuses the pod VM AMI of the cluster; timeout 2h); apply-coco-workloads (installs sandboxed containers with peer pods on the spoke; timeout 2h). Handoff: openshift-cluster: configure-spoke-rbac (creates the cluster-admins group on the spoke and binds it to cluster-admin); create-access-paste (uploads console URL, kubeadmin password and kubeconfig to PrivateBin; stores the paste URL); finalize-spoke (deletes leftover installer pods and the kubeadmin Secret on the spoke). extract-spoke-kubeconfig runs after git-clone. save-spoke-kubeconfig runs after extract-spoke-kubeconfig. create-cluster-cronjob runs after save-spoke-kubeconfig. register-keycloak-client runs after save-spoke-kubeconfig. configure-spoke-oauth runs after register-keycloak-client. create-cluster-issuer runs after configure-spoke-oauth. request-ssl-cert runs after create-cluster-issuer. wait-for-ssl-ready runs after request-ssl-cert. extract-cert-material runs after wait-for-ssl-ready. configure-spoke-default-cert runs after extract-cert-material. apply-base-workloads runs after configure-spoke-default-cert when tier: base, virt, ai, coco. apply-virt-workloads runs after apply-base-workloads. add-baremetal-workers runs after apply-virt-workloads. apply-ai-workloads runs after apply-base-workloads. add-ai-workers runs after apply-ai-workloads when nvidia-gpu. prepare-podvm-aws runs after apply-base-workloads. build-podvm-image-aws runs after prepare-podvm-aws. apply-coco-workloads runs after build-podvm-image-aws. configure-spoke-rbac runs after apply-base-workloads. configure-spoke-rbac runs after add-baremetal-workers. configure-spoke-rbac runs after add-ai-workers. configure-spoke-rbac runs after apply-coco-workloads. create-access-paste runs after configure-spoke-rbac. finalize-spoke runs after create-access-paste. Constraints: Trigger: trigger-post-provision of the provision pipeline creates the PipelineRun; the EventListener starts one for a request whose body holds action: post-provision. Start: load-config and git-clone have no runAfter and start first. openshift-cluster: false in a vCluster test run; the tasks in the two openshift-cluster frames are then skipped. Tier: every tier applies the base overlay; the virt, ai or coco branch runs for a cluster of that tier. Timeout: 5h for the whole run.
svg.text: Twenty-three tasks configure identity, TLS and RBAC on the spoke, apply the tier workloads, and publish the access details.
